newsitem.title: GREECE: VAKALO SCHOOL OF ARTS HOLDS EXHIBITION OF FAMOUS DESIGNER.
newsitem.headline: VAKALO SCHOOL OF ARTS HOLDS EXHIBITION OF FAMOUS DESIGNER.

text.p: The Athens-based Vakalo School of Arts is holding an exhibition of set design drawings of its famous founder George Vakalo at its newly built premises in Lycabetus on Thursday, it said in a statement.

"The new venue will become a cultural centre for many local and international art events and exhibitions," said the school's director Daniel Gounaridis. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
